==Description==
The '''Surf & Turf Battle Pass''' is the fourteenth pass to be added to the game. It is a summer-themed battle pass that was not related to an event. The pass started on the 9th of July 2025 at 19:00 UTC and ended on the 3rd of September 2025.

==Battle Pass==
[[File:Surf&TurfPass.png|center|450px]]
'''Surf & Turf Battle Pass''' used {{BeachBalls|Beach Balls}} as its currency, which were collected from enemies. These enemies dropped between one and three currency on death, which were collected by walking near them. These currency drops did not give one {{BeachBalls|Beach Balls}} each. The number varied based on the mode played, and it could be boosted by the [[Battlepass Boost]] modifier, which was occasionally enabled by the developers. It would boost the rewards by 50%.

While the battle pass did have a set amount for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, that being {{BeachBalls|800}} which when divided by total waves would make it give {{BeachBalls|16}}, this did not work and [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode instead gave nothing.

In total, it took {{BeachBalls|27,080}} to complete the battle pass. The battle pass had two tracks, the regular track could be obtained for free and the premium track was purchasable for {{Robux|399}}. Without the sale, it had a cost of {{Robux|499}}.

Certain items like [[High Grade Crate]]s were given out multiple times. In total, the '''Surf & Turf Battle Pass''' gave out {{Coins|4,250}}, {{Exp|2,700}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|12}}, 12 [[Heatwave]]s, 4 [[High Grade Crate]]s, 2 [[Premium Crate]]s, {{SpinTicket|15}}, 15 [[Sandcastle (Consumable)|Sandcastles]] and 9 [[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monsters]].

==Trivia==
*When the '''Surf & Turf Battle Pass''' first released, the individual skip costs were actually far cheaper than skipping them all, allowing for players to save {{Robux|1,390}} by just skipping each Level one by one, an issue inherited from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]].
**The following list is every change made to fix the issue. As the fix for the prices was not perfect, additional notes will be added for the new inaccuracies.
***Level 7 cost increased from {{Robux|44}} to {{Robux|84}}.
***Level 10 cost increased from {{Robux|150}} to {{Robux|210}}.
***Level 15 cost increased from {{Robux|160}} to {{Robux|235}}.
***Level 18 cost increased from {{Robux|66}} to {{Robux|116}}.
***Level 20 cost increased from {{Robux|170}} to {{Robux|270}}.
***Level 23 cost increased from {{Robux|76}} to {{Robux|126}}.
***Level 24 cost increased from {{Robux|78}} to {{Robux|128}}.
***Level 25 cost increased from {{Robux|180}} to {{Robux|305}}.
***Level 27 cost increased from {{Robux|84}} to {{Robux|86}}.
****The previous cost was actually correct. It was unnecessarily increased by {{Robux|2}}, making it slightly too expensive.
***Level 28 cost increased from {{Robux|86}} to {{Robux|136}}.
***Level 30 cost increased from {{Robux|190}} to {{Robux|340}}.
***Level 33 cost increased from {{Robux|96}} to {{Robux|146}}.
***Level 34 cost increased from {{Robux|98}} to {{Robux|158}}.
***Level 35 cost increased from {{Robux|200}} to {{Robux|420}}.
***Level 39 cost increased from {{Robux|108}} to {{Robux|166}}.
****While the increase did mostly correct the issue, the individual skip cost is still cheaper, but now only by {{Robux|2}}. This also cancels out the unnecessary increase from Level 27.
***Level 40 cost increased from {{Robux|210}} to {{Robux|460}}.
